headline: jasmine-sharma - Latest hindi news, हिंदी न्यूज़ लाइव on News18 हिंदी
content: Jasmine Sharma is a Senior Anchor and Deputy Producer with the News18 Network, based in Noida, Delhi NCR. With 10 years of experience in broadcast journalism, she contributes to news coverage, special programming, exclusive interviews, and regional reporting for News18 Delhi NCR. Originally from Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, Jasmine specialises in stories from northern India, particularly Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, and Delhi NCR. Her work spans regional politics, national affairs, security, civic issues, education, and geopolitics. She brings a strong understanding of the Himalayan region, with extensive experience covering Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, and developments concerning Pakistan and Afghanistan. Her professional strengths include live news anchoring, editorial research, content production, exclusive interviews, and ground reporting. She has covered significant political and security developments and continues to highlight issues affecting communities across northern India. A recent professional highlight was her exclusive interaction with His Holiness the Dalai Lama, during which she asked about Tibet’s future amid changing global conflicts. His response, “The Tibet issue will always remain alive,” became a key News18 exclusive. A postgraduate in Journalism and Mass Communication from Himachal Pradesh University, Shimla, Jasmine combines on-air expertise with editorial insight and a strong regional perspective, bringing important stories to wider audiences through television and digital platforms. Pakistan Diplomacy Fail Over Taliban: भारत और पाकिस्तान जब अलग हुए तो पाकिस्तान के बाद न तो संसाधनों की कमी थी और न ही जमीन की. हालांकि इस देश ने अपने संसाधनों का इस्तेमाल पॉजिटिव तरीके से करने के बजाय दूसरे को गिराने में किया. भारत के अंदर आतंकवाद का जहर घोलने के चक्कर में उसने खुद को ही इस दलदल में धंसा लिया. अब, जब खुद उसकी नीति उस पर ही बैकफायर कर रही है तो वो दुनियाभर में रोना रो रहा है. ...
